core_claims.name: appendAssoc / appendRightNil / sizeAppend
core_claims.scope: Append associativity, right identity and length-additivity for every list over an arbitrary element type.

core_claims.name: reverseAppend / reverseInvolutive / shuntCorrect / reversesAgree
core_claims.scope: Reverse/append distribution, reverse involution, the generalized accumulator invariant for every accumulator, and equality of optimized and direct reverse.

core_claims.name: mapCompose / mapAppend / foldAppend / foldCons / mapAsFold / mapTree / foldTree / mapTreeAsFold
core_claims.scope: Generic map composition/distribution, fold fusion over append without monoid assumptions, constructor reconstruction, and list/tree map-as-fold laws with arbitrary payload types and functions.

core_claims.name: MonoidLaw / additionMonoid / multiplicationMonoid / appendMonoid / foldMonoid / foldMonoidAppend / foldLeftInvariant / foldDirectionsAgree
core_claims.scope: Explicit associativity and both unit proofs for three monoids; generalized fold laws and equality of folding directions for any supplied monoid, without requiring commutativity.

core_claims.name: sumDownFromTimes
core_claims.scope: For every natural n including zero, mul (sumList (downFrom n)) 2 = mul n (monus n 1), exactly the upstream division-free arithmetic-series claim.

core_claims.name: All / Any / Member / firstZero / secondZero / threeAbsent
core_claims.scope: Proof-relevant indexed evidence for all elements, one selected position, and membership; examples retain duplicate zero positions and refute membership of three.

core_claims.name: allAppendIso / anyAppendIff / notAnyIff
core_claims.scope: Full data Iso splitting All over append; logical equivalence locating Any in one part; logical equivalence of refuted Any and All of refutations.

core_claims.name: allForall / allForallLeft / allForallPointwise / anyExistsIso
core_claims.scope: All corresponds to membership-indexed universal evidence with an evidence-tree inverse and a pointwise function inverse; Any has a full data Iso with an element/membership/predicate dependent package.

core_claims.name: decAll / decAny / Merge / split
core_claims.scope: Given a total decision for the element predicate, decide All and Any and construct two lists with positive/negative All evidence plus a Merge proof accounting for the entire original list in order, including duplicates.

deviations: Uses built-in Idris List with explicit tutorial append/map/fold implementations rather than redeclaring list syntax.

The upstream extensional Iso for negated Any is retained as Iff; the All/universal Iso is retained as Iff with an evidence-tree inverse and pointwise inverse, without a whole-function extensionality axiom. The Any/existential data Iso is fully proved.
Quadratic versus linear reverse traversal is an informal structural cost explanation, not a formally proved machine-cost theorem.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
